skip_intro.name: Skip intro
skip_intro.about: Starts at the main menu: no notice screens, studio logo, intro movie or title screen. Loading still takes as long.

fast_menus.name: Fast menus
fast_menus.about: Skips menu transitions, also in the pause menu and on the screens after a match. Matches, movies and the credits are unchanged.

no_mega_strikes.name: No Mega Strikes
no_mega_strikes.about: Mega Strikes are off for both teams, the usual competitive rule. Skillshots stay, and Strikers 101 lessons keep their own rules.

unlock_all.name: Unlock everything
unlock_all.about: All characters, stadiums and cheats, through the game's own unlock switch. Your save is not changed; cup finals then no longer feature the locked captains.

cpu_vs_cpu.name: CPU vs CPU
cpu_vs_cpu.about: The CPU plays both teams in Domination if you press Done on Choose Sides without picking a side. Any controller can still pause, and Choose Sides in the pause menu can hand a match over to the CPU too.

fast_terrain.name: Fast terrain
fast_terrain.about: Every stadium plays like the fast, dry field of Bowser Stadium: same running speed, ball roll and bounce, no sliding on ice or mud, no slow sand in the Sand Tomb. Looks and hazards stay; online matches are unchanged.

mirror_match.name: Mirror match
mirror_match.about: Both teams can pick the same captain in Domination. The away team wears an away kit, in the menus too: the game's own, or for Mario, Luigi, Wario and Waluigi one made from their kit (blue, sky blue, blue, orange). Online matches are unchanged.

thunder_island_walls.name: Thunder Island walls
thunder_island_walls.about: Thunder Island's open sides get the electric fence of every other stadium: the ball and items bounce off, and players knocked into it are electrocuted instead of falling off the island. The fence stays invisible; online matches are unchanged.

blue_peach.name: Blue Peach
blue_peach.about: Peach's team wears her unused blue and yellow kit on the field: Peach, her sidekicks and her goalie. The game has no blue menu pictures, Mega Strike hand, banners or crowd for it, so those stay pink.

fair_ball_contests.name: Feder's fair ball contests
fair_ball_contests.about: When players of both teams reach a loose ball at once, the defending team (the one whose goal is on the ball's side of the field) takes it. On the Wii the home was favoured instead: the Wii game updates the players in an order it shuffles at kickoff, slightly in the home team's favour, and settles one-timers, first-time shots off rebounds and pass receptions with the home team always first. Named after Feder, who made a Gecko code for this on the Wii. On by default; online matches always play with it.

robot_goalies.name: Robot goalies
robot_goalies.about: Both goalies wear the robot Kritter skin of the Super Team from Super Mario Strikers, which the game's disc still holds unused: red lens eyes, metal plating and the robot jersey. Only the look changes.

super_team.name: Super Team (Work in Progress)
super_team.about: A team's captain and sidekicks become the robots of the Super Team from Super Mario Strikers, fitted to each character's size. Needs a Super Mario Strikers (GameCube) disc image. Bowser, Petey Piranha and Boo keep their own look; only the look changes.

secure_stadiums.name: Secure stadiums
secure_stadiums.about: The game's Secure Stadium cheat in every offline match: no lightning, wind, flying debris, solar flares, bubbling lava, Storm Ship tilt, Thwomps or sand patches. The electric fences stay. Striker Challenges keep their rules; online matches are unchanged.

match_point.name: Match point
match_point.about: In a match to a number of goals, the kickoff that finds both teams one goal from winning plays overtime's siren and sudden death music in place of the stadium's, until the match ends, and the HUD shows SUDDEN DEATH instead of First to. Only sound and HUD change. On by default.

override_retail_menus.name: Override retail menus (Dev)
override_retail_menus.about: Development switch: Recharged's own versions replace the game's menus as they are built, starting with the pause menu in a match, drawn over the blurred game. They open the same pages and do the same as the game's. On by default; off shows the game's own menus.

effects_volume.name: Sound effects
effects_volume.about: Kicks, tackles, items, the electric fence, stadium and weather sounds.

voice_volume.name: Voices
voice_volume.about: The characters' voice lines, also in the menus.

crowd_volume.name: Crowd
crowd_volume.about: The stadium crowd's cheering and chants.

menu_volume.name: Menus & HUD
menu_volume.about: Menu clicks and prompts, the studio logo's jingle and the sounds of the match's on-screen display.

cutscene_volume.name: Cutscenes
cutscene_volume.about: Captain introductions, goal celebrations, Mega Strikes and the scenes after a match, with their own music and voices.

movie_volume.name: Movies
movie_volume.about: The intro movie, the stadium previews and the credits.

stretch.name: Stretch the picture
stretch.about: Fills the window (stretched, or the wider view in matches), or keeps the 16:9 or 4:3 shape. For this run.

panel.name: Recharged Game Menu
panel.about: Opens it over the game, as HOME does; Escape closes it.

game_options.name: Game options
game_options.about: Opens the Recharged Game Menu on its Game options tab.
